artboards.name: 08.10 · L163 · V1 · Fit memory · Detail
artboards.state: Saved photo-only private memory, 6 October 2026, same note, Not linked. Full-image Fit. No Share/Post/likes/followers.

actions.Back: Restore originating Profile and journal scroll

actions.Link outfit: Open the same editor draft focused on outfit selection; commit only through Save
actions.More: Native anchored Menu with Delete memory command only; dismiss before confirmation; outside tap leaves memory unchanged
actions.Delete memory: Native scoped confirmation: Delete this fit memory from 6 October 2026? Removes only this memory, its private note/snapshot and unreferenced AQD-owned photo copies. Keeps outfits, wear history, other memories and original Photos. Actions Delete memory (destructive) / Cancel (safe).

artboards.return: Cancel deletion restores unchanged detail and More focus. Confirmed deletion returns to Profile, which shows L160 only if actually empty. Deletion failure retains memory with retry; do not show a false successful deletion.

sharedSemantics.privacy: Private local journal; no upload, social surface or implicit Agent context.
sharedSemantics.wear: Adding, editing, linking, unlinking or deleting memories never records wear or changes plans/counts.
sharedSemantics.outfitOnly: Existing outfit alone is sufficient; show actual piece composition/snapshot, never fabricated wearer imagery.
sharedSemantics.validation: Date-only/note-only drafts cannot save. Removing last photo/link cannot save an empty record. Retain over-limit input, never truncate.
